public_rationale: On February 27, 2025, Decrypt reported GPT-4.5 API prices of $75 per million input tokens and $150 per million output tokens [e1]. It described GPT-4.5 as “ten times pricier” than Claude 3.7 Sonnet, supporting a very large launch price premium, though the comparison did not specify which token charge it meant [e1]. OpenAI also described GPT-4.5 as more expensive than GPT-4o that day [e2].
limitations: The report does not establish separate input and output price ratios against Claude 3.7 Sonnet.
The evidence documents launch pricing, not daily comparisons throughout February 27–March 5, 2025.
The external comparison covers one competitor, not a comprehensive competitor basket.
The evidence does not establish subscription value, cost per successful task, or future model costs.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable contemporaneous prices show GPT-4.5 broadly priced near or below competing frontier models.
